scope: Independent offline interface review; not physical model validation
resolved_findings: Policy age now uses same board-snapshot proxy as the actual SDK; actual transport age is diagnostic-only.
Causal reset warmup aligns100Hz decisions with delayed telemetry delivery and removes the false3ms+3ms lease gap.
Unusable telemetry ignores numeric Gym actions and lets the original lease expire without fresh demand.
reviewed_behavior: Raw acceleration enters the binary32 governor once per1ms tick.
Quantized raw angle initializes a zero-rate causal observer; no true omega in policy channels.
Step count and commanded velocity/acceleration are explicit estimates; force saturation terminates unsupported tracking.
Action expiry remains observed_snapshot+TTL; command transport never renews it.
The shared policy codec selects explicit channels and never reads simulation diagnostics or truth.
limitations: Plant still assumes ideal cart acceleration tracking below a declared force ceiling; cart step ISR phase/backlash/missed steps and global magnetic calibration are unvalidated.
Initial healthy snapshot is an explicit preflight assumption; delayed reset advances real model time under zero demand.
With100Hz control and20ms TTL, combined transport delays above10ms can legitimately create gaps between leases.
Faulted reset states outside the declared startup assumptions are not a physical safe-start demonstration.
